nodes.description: ZNF668 binds Tip60 and promotes acetylation of histone H2AX after ionizing radiation. Without ZNF668, H2AX hyperacetylation and the chromatin relaxation it drives are impaired, so repair proteins are recruited less efficiently to DNA lesions. Experimentally relaxing chromatin rescues the defect.

nodes.description: ZNF668 is a nucleolar protein that binds MDM2 and p53 and limits MDM2-mediated ubiquitination and degradation of p53. Its loss lowers basal p53 and blunts p53 stabilization after DNA damage. This was characterized as a tumor-suppressor function in breast cancer cells; whether it contributes to the neurodevelopmental disorder is unknown.
